fields.label: Rule type
fields.options:
Item Group
Ecommerce Property
Manufacturer
Item Field
Stock
Brand
fields.description: What the rule applies to: Item Group, Ecommerce Property, Manufacturer, Item Field, Stock, Brand.

fields.label: Feldname
fields.description: Name der Eigenschaft (Ecommerce Property) oder des Artikel-Feldes (Item Field). Leer lassen bei Item Group / Manufacturer / Brand / Stock.

fields.label: Operator
fields.options:
equals
not_equals
in
not_in
descends_from
contains
regex
is_set
is_empty
fields.description: Comparison operator: equals, not_equals, in = is one of (comma-separated), not_in, descends_from = is descended from (for the item-group tree), contains, regex, is_set, is_empty.

fields.label: Wert
fields.description: Single value, or comma-separated for 'in' / 'not_in'. Ignored for 'is_set' / 'is_empty'.

fields.label: OR-Gruppe
fields.description: Rules with the same OR-group number (except 0) are combined with OR. Different OR-groups are combined via the Smart Collection's rule combinator.

fields.label: Negieren (NICHT)
fields.description: Kehrt die Regel um. Hinweis: NULL-Behandlung ist streng — ein nicht gesetzter Wert passt nie, daher ist NICHT(Regel) nicht identisch mit der Operator-Verneinung, wenn die Eigenschaft fehlt.
